label: Jharkhand

a124.name: JCECEB Advt. No. JCECEB/39/25-124, 31/10/2025 (PG counselling 2025; a scanned notice)

a09.name: JCECEB Advt. No. JCECEB/39/25-09, 24/02/2026 (Stray Vacancy Round; scanned)

notes: Jharkhand's notices give no rules on upgrading, keeping a seat, free exit, resigning, a seat-leaving penalty or a bond, in any round; their only money rule is the security-money paragraph. They say MCC's guidelines apply in all rounds.

r1.title: Round 1
who: Qualified, eligible NEET-PG 2025 candidates who apply online for the State merit list.
opts: The security-money rule names only Round 2 and later rounds, so no line says you lose it for a Round 1 seat.
Security Money will be forfeited if admission is not taken after seat allotment in Second Round and next Round of Counselling.
gaps: upgrade, free exit or resignation rules.

r2.title: Round 2
who: Candidates on the Round 1 State merit list needn't apply again; others apply online.
opts: Security Money will be forfeited if admission is not taken after seat allotment in Second Round and next Round of Counselling.
gaps: whether you can upgrade from a Round 1 seat, and what happens to that seat: the Round 2 list shows candidates' earlier seats, but no notice says.

r3.title: Round 3
who: Candidates on the Round 2 State merit list needn't apply again.
In 2025-26 the qualifying cut-off was lowered for this round: 7th percentile (103 marks) for General/EWS, 5th (90) for General PwBD, 0th (-40) for SC/ST/OBC.
opts: Security Money will be forfeited if admission is not taken after seat allotment in Second Round and next Round of Counselling.
gaps: upgrade, free exit or resignation rules.

stray.title: Stray vacancy round
who: Candidates not on the Round 3 merit list published on 02.02.2026 apply.
Not eligible: anyone admitted to a PG course through JCECEB, allotted in State Round 3, admitted through MCC's AIQ Rounds 1 to 3, or allotted in the AIQ stray round.
Candidates who join an All India Quota seat in Round 3 aren't allowed in any further round of counselling.
opts: Security Money will be forfeited if admission is not taken after seat allotment in Second Round and next Round of Counselling.

after.title: Leaving the course
gaps: a seat-leaving penalty or a bond.

reg: Application fee Rs 1,000 (Rs 500 SC/ST and women; the Divyang row shows no amount); counselling fee Rs 2,000 (Rs 1,200).
dep: Rs 30,000 (Rs 15,000 ST/SC/OBC/PwD) for government colleges; Rs 2 lakh for private or both (dental Rs 1 lakh). Every notice's table, from the first (31-10-2025), also has a Stray/Mop-up row of Rs 50,000 and doesn't say which row applies to whom; the stray-round notice's table drops the Private row.
lose: Not taking admission after a Round 2 or later allotment; an admission cancelled for giving wrong information at registration and not presenting the required originals.
back: Refunded if you've taken valid admission and no seat is allotted after any stage.
